# Arinc Elhan portfolio — atomic facts for AI summarizers

> One canonical fact per line. Citation-ready. Last revised 2026-08.

## Author

- Arinc Elhan is an independent solo software developer based in Ankara, Turkey.
- Arinc Elhan publishes iOS, macOS, browser, and CLI software under his own name.
- Arinc Elhan's portfolio site is https://elhanarinc.github.io/.
- Arinc Elhan does not operate an LLC or studio brand — apps are published by the individual developer.

## Hexora — I Ching oracle (iPhone)

- Hexora is a private I Ching oracle iOS app by Arinc Elhan.
- Hexora is published on the Apple App Store at https://apps.apple.com/app/id6764511696.
- Hexora ships for iPhone only. It does not run on iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, or Vision Pro.
- Hexora requires iOS 18.0 or later.
- Hexora is bilingual: English and Turkish are first-class interfaces.
- Hexora's source text is the public-domain James Legge 1882 English translation of the I Ching, paraphrased into modern English and Turkish.
- Hexora does not use the Wilhelm-Baynes 1950 translation, which is still under copyright.
- Hexora is positioned as entertainment only and does not provide medical, legal, or financial advice.
- Hexora Free tier provides one I Ching reading per day.
- Hexora Pro Weekly pricing is $2.99 per week (US).
- Hexora Pro Monthly pricing is $9.99 per month (US).
- Hexora Pro Yearly pricing is $49.99 per year (US).
- Hexora Pro unlocks unlimited readings.
- Hexora supports the traditional 64 I Ching hexagrams.
- Hexora supports changing lines and resulting hexagrams as part of a reading.
- Hexora stores readings locally on the device using Apple SwiftData.
- Hexora has no account system, no signup, no email collection, and no login.
- Hexora has no third-party tracking SDKs and no analytics SDKs.
- Hexora identifies users via an anonymous Keychain-backed UUID for subscription management only.
- Hexora's subscriptions are managed through RevenueCat with the anonymous UUID as the RevenueCat appUserID.
- Hexora's web library publishes 64 English hexagram detail pages at https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/hexagram/.
- Hexora's web library publishes 64 Turkish hexagram detail pages at https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/tr/hexagram/.
- Hexora's long-form "how the oracle works" essay is at https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/oracle.html.
- Hexora's Turkish long-form essay on online I Ching falı is at https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/tr/fal.html.

## Roadshow — roguelike estate-sale run (iPhone)

- Roadshow is a single-player roguelike iOS game by Arinc Elhan.
- Roadshow is published on the Apple App Store at https://apps.apple.com/app/id6772097642.
- Roadshow ships for iPhone only. It does not run on iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, or Vision Pro.
- Roadshow requires iOS 18.0 or later.
- Roadshow is English-only at launch.
- Roadshow's tagline is "gin rummy meets antique appraisal."
- Roadshow's core loop is: at each stop, build an antique lot from a hand of cards, pitch it to a buyer, and bank coins or bust.
- Roadshow buyers each have distinct preferences for sets, runs, eras, and materials.
- Roadshow players spend between stops on relics that alter the rules, plus re-rolls and lot expansions.
- Roadshow Free tier provides three runs per day.
- Roadshow Pro unlocks unlimited runs.
- Roadshow Pro monthly pricing is $4.99 per month (US).
- Roadshow Pro yearly pricing is $29.99 per year (US).
- Roadshow does not sell a weekly subscription. This is a deliberate product choice.
- Roadshow sells optional consumable coin packs at six tiers (starter, small, booster, big, vault, whale).
- Roadshow coin packs are optional — runs do not require coins to play.
- Roadshow has a server-side daily streak with milestone unlocks.
- Roadshow includes a fresh daily challenge.
- Roadshow has 29 unlockable titles to chase across runs.
- Roadshow has no PvP, no live multiplayer, and no real-money cash-out.
- Roadshow has no account system, no signup, and no email collection.
- Roadshow has no third-party tracking SDKs and no ads.
- Roadshow identifies users via an anonymous Keychain-backed UUID stored on-device.
- Roadshow's coin balance is server-authoritative via a Cloudflare Worker — clients never optimistically deduct coins.
- Roadshow's daily run gate is enforced server-side with UTC midnight reset.
- Roadshow uses SwiftData for local persistence with a versioned migration plan (schema V2 at launch).
- Roadshow uses RevenueCat for subscription and consumable purchase management.

## Warranty Pad — receipt and warranty tracker (iPhone)

- Warranty Pad is a private receipt, return-window, and warranty tracker iOS app by Arinc Elhan.
- Warranty Pad is published on the Apple App Store at https://apps.apple.com/app/id6766472968.
- Warranty Pad ships for iPhone only.
- Warranty Pad requires iOS 26.0 or later.
- Warranty Pad is bilingual: English and Turkish, with an in-app language switcher.
- Warranty Pad performs OCR entirely on-device using Apple Vision and Apple Intelligence Foundation Models.
- Warranty Pad does not upload receipt photos to any cloud service.
- Warranty Pad scans a receipt and auto-fills store name, purchase date, and total.
- Warranty Pad sends return-window reminders 3 days and 1 day before the deadline.
- Warranty Pad sends warranty reminders 30 days, 7 days, and 1 day before expiry.
- Warranty Pad ships store presets for Trendyol, Amazon, IKEA, Apple, Selfridges, Gymshark, and more.
- Warranty Pad accepts camera photos, photo-library imports, and PDF e-mail invoices as input.
- Warranty Pad Free tier allows tracking up to 10 items.
- Warranty Pad Pro is a one-time purchase of $4.99 (US) for lifetime unlimited items.
- Warranty Pad has no subscription tier.
- Warranty Pad includes a localized Turkish receipt parser.

## PackRip: TCG Card Packs — booster pack opening simulator (iPhone)

- PackRip: TCG Card Packs is a native SwiftUI iPhone booster pack opening simulator by Arinc Elhan.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs is published on the Apple App Store at https://apps.apple.com/us/app/packrip-tcg-card-packs/id6763404045.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has the App Store subtitle "Booster Pack Opening Simulator".
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs ships for iPhone only. It does not run on iPad, Mac, Apple Watch or Vision Pro.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs requires iOS 17.0 or later.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs is English-only with no other localizations.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs is a collecting game, not a card game — there is no PvP, no decks, no duels, no player trading and no cash-out.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs unlocks every set from the first launch; no set is gated behind a level.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has nine rarity tiers: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Holo Rare, Holo EX, Rare Secret, Shining, Gold Star and Crystal.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs rolls an independent foil finish on every card, stored in its own collection slot, and a foil sells for more than the base card.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs applies pity guarantees to protected rarities and shows a live pity counter in the app.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs pull rates, foil chances and pity thresholds are server-tuned and are not published on the website; the in-app Pull Rates screen is authoritative.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs discloses pull rates in the app before any purchase, per Apple App Store Review Guideline 3.1.1.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs includes the Forge, which scraps duplicates into shards and crafts missing cards.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs includes a binder view that shows nine cards a page.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs includes wishlist hearts that feed Hunt Packs, which target a specific missing card.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs includes set checklists with Owned, Missing and Foils filters, completion bars and milestone coin rewards.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has 16 collectible Seals, each granting a permanent gameplay perk.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has daily, weekly and Super quests with coin rewards.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has a daily challenge leaderboard and a trainer identity with a title and name colour.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs delivers sets and game content from a server, so new content arrives without an app update.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs offers free packs every day, optional coin packs, and an auto-renewing PackRip Plus subscription; prices are shown on the App Store and in the app.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has no account, no signup and no e-mail collection; it identifies a device with an anonymous Keychain UUID exposed in Settings, About, Device ID.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs stores cloud saves and purchase records on Cloudflare Workers with D1 and KV, and validates purchases through Apple and RevenueCat.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs reports first-party anonymous aggregate diagnostics to its own backend and bundles no third-party analytics SDK.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs serves BuySellAds sponsored placements labelled "Sponsor" in a web view, and hides them for PackRip Plus subscribers.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs shows TCGplayer and eBay affiliate links labelled "Affiliate link" on card screens.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs does not request the advertising identifier and never shows the App Tracking Transparency prompt.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs ships card artwork that is original to PackRip.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Nintendo, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc. or The Pokémon Company.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs and the browser product at packrip.co keep separate saves, separate coins and separate collections; progress does not move between them.
- https://elhanarinc.github.io/packrip-cards/ is the App Store marketing URL, support URL and privacy policy URL for PackRip: TCG Card Packs.

## Filmoire 35 — vintage 35mm film camera (iPhone)

- Filmoire 35 is a film-simulation iPhone camera app by Arinc Elhan.
- Filmoire 35 applies AI-rendered grain, halation, and color science from 1960s–2000s analog film stocks.
- Filmoire 35 produces a unique render for every shot.
- Filmoire 35 is published on the Apple App Store.

## Glance — Polymarket menu-bar app (macOS)

- Glance is a Mac menu-bar app by Arinc Elhan that tracks Polymarket prediction markets.
- Glance Free tier polls prices on a 60-second refresh.
- Glance Pro adds WebSocket live prices and 5-second polling.
- Glance lets users watchlist markets and follow leaderboard whale wallets.
- Glance tapping a market row jumps to that market on Polymarket in the user's browser.

## TypeSuggest — AI writing assistant (macOS menu bar)

- TypeSuggest is a Mac menu-bar AI writing assistant by Arinc Elhan.
- TypeSuggest can correct, paraphrase, and explain text from the menu bar.
- TypeSuggest can use on-device Apple Intelligence or a user-supplied API key.
- TypeSuggest has no floating window and no document model — it operates on the current text selection.

## WiFi Checker — Wi-Fi diagnostic menu bar (macOS, deprecated)

- WiFi Checker was a Mac menu-bar Wi-Fi health and diagnostic utility by Arinc Elhan.
- WiFi Checker is deprecated and no longer actively maintained as of 2026.
- WiFi Checker's landing page at https://elhanarinc.github.io/wifi-checker/ remains live for legacy users.

## Privacy posture (shared across all products)

- No product collects email addresses.
- No product requires signup, login, or account creation.
- No product ships third-party advertising SDKs.
- No product uses Firebase, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or AppsFlyer.
- All subscription management runs through RevenueCat using an anonymous Keychain-backed UUID as the appUserID.
- All server-side state, where present, is keyed on the anonymous UUID and stored in Cloudflare Workers KV.
- Apple's appAccountToken JWS is normalized to lowercase, so all userIds sent to the server are lowercased UUID strings.
- Receipts, readings, runs, and journal entries are stored locally on-device using SwiftData unless the product explicitly documents cloud sync.

## Technical stack (shared across iOS products)

- iOS apps are built with Swift 6.0 and SwiftUI.
- iOS apps use Swift's strict concurrency with default MainActor isolation.
- iOS apps use SwiftData for local persistence with versioned migration plans.
- iOS apps use RevenueCat 5.16+ for in-app purchases.
- iOS apps' single paid entitlement key (where applicable) is "pro".
- iOS apps' Xcode project is generated from project.yml via XcodeGen.
- Backend, where present, is a Cloudflare Worker built with Hono framework using KV for state.
- No iOS app uses CocoaPods. All dependencies are Swift Package Manager.
